question: Which of the following is a tributary of the river Godavari?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Penganga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Penganga **is a tributary of the river Godavari.
 
• The Penganga River is a tributary of the **Wardha River**, which is a tributary of the **Pranhita River**, which flows into the **Godavari.**
 
• The Godavari is the biggest east-flowing river in India.<
